findings.claim: the Notting Hill race riots had occurred just weeks before the play’s premiere
findings.truth: The play premiered on 27 May 1958; the Notting Hill riots took place later, in late August and early September 1958.
findings.evidence: University of Warwick Modern Records Centre, The 1958 riots; fetched Methuen Student Edition production listing

findings.claim: It premieres at a moment of racial tension (Notting Hill riots, weeks earlier)
findings.truth: The Notting Hill riots were later in 1958, after the May premiere.
findings.evidence: University of Warwick Modern Records Centre, The 1958 riots; fetched Methuen Student Edition production listing

findings.claim: Shelagh Delaney ... wrote A Taste of Honey at eighteen
findings.truth: Reliable theatre and university sources identify Delaney as 19 when she wrote or submitted the completed play in 1958.
findings.evidence: University of London, My Usual Self is a Very Unusual Self; Bloomsbury student-edition preview

findings.claim: the play ends with Geof leaving Jo for good, leaving Jo and Helen alone together
findings.truth: The fetched text and National Theatre rehearsal pack place Geof’s departure before Helen leaves the flat; Jo is alone as labour begins. L01, L03 and L07 instead build their ending analysis around Jo and Helen being left together. Options: revise those claims and their dependent questions to the actual ending, or explicitly recast them as hypothetical production choices. Recommend the first option.
findings.evidence: Fetched Methuen Student Edition text; National Theatre A Taste of Honey background pack
findings.ruling: NOTE + needs-rebuild: the ending (Geof leaves, then Helen walks out, Jo alone as labour begins) is wrong across L1/L3/L7 and their questions - not surgical.

findings.claim: live jazz musicians on stage throughout the performance
findings.truth: Research on the original production places the Apex Jazz Trio in an ornate box beside the stage, where performers acknowledged and interacted with them. L01, L04–L06 and L08 repeatedly instead say the original band was on stage. Options: correct every historical-production claim to the box placement, or distinguish the original staging from a modern on-stage revival. Recommend the first option.
findings.evidence: Patton, Jazz and Music-Hall Transgressions in Theatre Workshop’s Production of A Taste of Honey, New Theatre Quarterly (Cambridge)
findings.ruling: NOTE: original Apex Jazz Trio sat in a box beside the stage; recurs in five lessons; rebuild item.

findings.claim: the recurring L01–L08 exam tips frame 12-mark set-play work as playwright-intentions analysis and 20-mark work as a combined performer-and-designer staging response
findings.truth: The specification makes the set-play section extract-based and distinguishes performer and designer perspectives. Official AQA assessment material uses an 8-mark performance task, a 12-mark interaction/space task and a 20-mark response in either performance or one design specialism. Options: revise all affected tips to that structure, or remove the mark-specific format claims while retaining the house practice prompts. Recommend revising the tips; no edit is supplied because it spans every lesson.
findings.evidence: specs/aqa/drama-8261-8261.md, assessment section; AQA June 2022 GCSE Drama assessment material
findings.ruling: NOTE: drama-aqa 12/20-mark framing - subject-wide relabel item (8-mark performance, 12-mark interaction/space, 20-mark performer-or-one-design).

findings.truth: The fetched set-text copy does not state Jo’s age. Frances Cuka, who originated Jo, recalled that the character was 15, while several modern summaries give 17, which is also the film character’s age. Options: change L02’s exact-age claims to ‘teenage’, or retain 17 only after checking the prescribed edition. Recommend neutralising the age.
findings.evidence: Fetched Methuen Student Edition text; Frances Cuka interview, Studs Terkel Radio Archive; film reference material
findings.ruling: FIX: Jo's age neutralised to teenage.

summary: Checked all eight lessons against the AQA specification, fetched primary-text material and reliable historical or theatre sources. Three verified factual issues receive ten surgical edits; four wider issues are retained for adjudication.
